versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00248 The RTE shall consider the headerLength information in the BufferProperties if inPlace in the BufferProperties is set: • On the sending side (transformation) the RTE shall increase the buffer from the beginning by the size given in headerLength . • On the receiving side (retransformation) the RTE shall decrease the buffer from the beginning by the size given in headerLength .
